# C05-05 — Evidence-derived guide

Status: verified

- Requirements: ST-009, ST-015, ST-016
- Evaluations: EV-002, EV-015
- Inputs: approved plan/storyboard, compatible evidence and optional existing manual references
- Output: versioned explainers/tutorial guides with citations and explicit gaps
- Dependencies: C04-02, C03-02, C02-01
- Acceptance: guide steps and claims derive from the same evidence as media; existing manuals are referenced, not silently overwritten
- Verification: valid guide, incompatible evidence, missing step and manual provenance cases
- Limit: generated documentation does not establish evidence truth or replace product-owner review
